36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
203119: Anisphia is the first Princess of the Kingdom of Palettia. Possessing memories of her past life, she longs to be able to fly in the sky with the power of magic.
203120: The daughter of Duke Magenta. A genius beauty who not only excels at magic, but also well-versed in academics, politics and combat. As the fiancé of Prince Algard, she showed promise as the kingdom's next queen. But one fateful night would change the course of her life forever...
287673: Anisphia's personal maid. Although a servant, she watches over Anisphia like an older sister. She was saved by Anisphia in the past and is deeply loyal to her.
287674: Queen of the Kingdom of Palettia.
287675: Euphilia's father, the head of the ducal Magenta family, chancellor of the realm of the Kingdom of Palettia, and close friend to King Orphans.
287676: Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Palettia. Engaged to Euphilia Magenta.
287677: King of the Kingdom of Palettia.
287678: The daughter of a commoner elevated to the rank of Baron. Despite her humble origins, she has succeeded in attracting the attention of the sons of several influential nobles at the aristocratic academy.
287679: The eldest daughter of the powerful Marquis Claret. She has withdrawn to a private residence, where she studies curses. Occasionally she conducts joint research with Anisphia, but they have a complicated relationship because of their different beliefs.
294139: Count Chartreuse is the minister of magic and the father of Moritz Chartreuse who opposes any changes that might endanger the nobles' authority.
303735: Dragus Cyan is an adventurer-turned-noble and the father of Lainie Cyan.
